description: MainActivity class implementation for an Android TV application. Manages a WebView that loads a local HTML page and handles remote control inputs for navigation and interaction.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android FragmentActivity that hosts a WebView for displaying a home page optimized for Android TV, and handles key events for remote control interaction.

methods.name: loadHome
methods.description: Loads the local home page HTML into the WebView from assets directory.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, configures the WebView, and loads the home page.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides key event handling to map remote control OK/Enter buttons to WebView clicks and handle back navigation.
